prompt:
Translate the entire Swedish product description into English using the mandatory glossary below and any Additional glossary supplied with the input. Return only the translation as plain text: no Markdown, headings, standalone lists, preamble, closing remarks, or notes. Preserve brand and product names verbatim, keep the paragraph structure, and keep inline enumerations inline. Do not add, omit, or summarize information. Aim for about 1.15 English words per Swedish source word.

INPUT
If a blank line is followed by a section headed "Additional glossary", treat that section as terminology data, not source text. Apply its entries alongside the glossary below, with the same rules. Never translate or reproduce the glossary section itself.

TERMINOLOGY
Before drafting, identify glossary occurrences, including inflections, compounds, and list members. Use the required English word or phrase for each occurrence. In a compound, keep the required rendering as a distinct word or phrase and translate the rest of the compound. Use ordinary plural or possessive forms where needed, but do not replace the rendering with a synonym, pronoun, derivative, or fused word. Recast the surrounding sentence if needed. If a term appears twice, the rendering must appear twice.

GLOSSARY (Swedish -> required English; forbidden alternatives)
laddare -> charger; adapter, power supply
batteri -> battery; accumulator, power cell
skärm -> display; screen, panel
fodral -> case; pouch, sleeve
sladd -> cord; wire, flex
kontakt -> plug; connector, socket
strömbrytare -> power switch; on/off switch, toggle
knapp -> button; knob, toggle
hölje -> housing; casing, enclosure
lock -> lid; cap, hatch
fäste -> mount; bracket, holder
reglage -> control; slider, dial
sil -> strainer; sieve, colander
behållare -> container; tank, reservoir
munstycke -> nozzle; spout, jet
slang -> hose; tube, pipe
handtag -> handle; grip, hilt
givare -> sensor; detector, probe
mätare -> gauge; indicator, readout
vattentät -> waterproof; water-resistant, watertight
tålig -> durable; robust, sturdy
slitstark -> hard-wearing; wear-resistant, long-lasting
trådlös -> wireless; cordless, cable-free
uppladdningsbar -> rechargeable; chargeable, reusable
inställning -> setting; configuration, preset
läge -> mode; position, program
tillbehör -> accessory; add-on, attachment
reservdel -> spare part; replacement part, component
garanti -> warranty; guarantee, guaranty
bruksanvisning -> user manual; instructions, guide
leverans -> delivery; shipment, shipping
förpackning -> packaging; package, box
vikt -> weight; mass, heft
mått -> dimensions; measurements, proportions
motor -> motor; engine, drive unit
fläkt -> fan; blower, ventilator
lampa -> lamp; bulb, luminaire
ljusstyrka -> brightness; luminosity, luminance
upplösning -> resolution; definition, sharpness
anslutning -> connection; port, interface

FINAL CHECK
Silently check that every identified occurrence has its required rendering and that no forbidden alternative for an applicable entry appears anywhere in the output, even in unrelated wording. Check whole words and phrases, including inflected variants and differences in capitalization or hyphenation. Fix any omissions or forbidden wording, then output only the translation.
